description: How far a follower of the record has followed it, as every follower says it at its health port (WEAVER.md § Health, SMELTER.md § Health).

sweep.description: The latest sweep's phase: `pending` before its stream first opens, `running`, `done`, or `due` where the record could not be listed and the sweep is tried again.

stopped.description: How many resources' logs a failed taking has stopped until the next sweep.

refused.description: How many events it refused as recorded since it started.

streamDrops.description: How many times its stream has dropped since it started.
